drafter.private_reasoning: Use a balanced, mutual NDA framework: clarify permitted use and standard exclusions, make protection obligations reciprocal, address representatives and compelled disclosure, and resolve the mismatch between the stated agreement term and confidentiality period. Do not disclose or allude to the client’s confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our initial pass. We clarified the mutual use and protection obligations, added customary exclusions and handling provisions, and aligned the agreement term with the confidentiality survival period. Please let us know if you would like to discuss any of these points.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties may exchange information solely to evaluate and, if agreed, negotiate a potential transaction between them (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party or its affiliates (“Discloser”) to the other party or its representatives (“Recipient”), in any form, that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information does not include information Recipient can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was rightfully known to Recipient without confidentiality restrictions before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information.
edits.name: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION

edits.text: 2. PROTECTION AND PERMITTED USE. Recipient shall use Confidential Information only for the Purpose, protect it using at least reasonable care, and not disclose it except to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties at least as protective as this Agreement. Recipient is responsible for its representatives’ compliance. If disclosure is required by law or legal process, Recipient may disclose the required portion, and, to the extent legally permitted, shall give Discloser prompt notice and reasonably cooperate with efforts to obtain protective treatment. Upon Discloser’s written request, Recipient shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except that it may retain archival copies maintained in routine backups or as required by law, subject to this Agreement.
edits.name: 2. PROTECTION AND PERMITTED USE

edits.text: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL. This Agreement begins on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months, unless the parties agree in writing to extend it. Recipient’s obligations with respect to each item of Confidential Information continue for three years from its disclosure; trade secrets remain protected for so long as they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: 3. TERM; SURVIVAL

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO COMMITMENT. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the affected party may seek appropriate injunctive relief, in addition to other available remedies. Neither party is obligated to proceed with any transaction, and no license or other rights in Confidential Information are granted except the limited right to use it for the Purpose. Any transaction will be subject to definitive written agreements.
edits.name: 4. REMEDIES; NO COMMITMENT
